title: Studying paraben-induced estrogen receptor- and steroid hormone-related endocrine disruption effects via multi-level approaches.
authors: Liang, Jiefeng; Liu, Qian S; Ren, Zhihua; Min, Ke; Yang, Xiaoxi; Hao, Fang; Zhang, Qing; Liu, Qian; Zhou, Qunfang; Jiang, Guibin
journal: The Science of the total environment
one_liner_zh: 该文通过多水平实验和分子对接研究尼泊金酯类对雌激素受体及类固醇激素的干扰效应，虽涉及蛋白-配体结合，但对象为小分子-受体而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，仅分子对接作为辅助，与本课题TF-DNA互作建模关联较弱。
abstract: Increasing concerns have been raised on the health risks of parabens in the regard of their widespread applications and potential endocrine disrupting activities. In this study, four typical parabens, including methyl paraben (MeP), ethyl paraben (EtP), propyl paraben (PrP), and butyl paraben (BuP) were systematically investigated for their estrogen receptor- and steroid hormone-related endocrine disruptions using multi-level approaches. Paraben exposure promoted the proliferation of MCF-7 cells, increased the luciferase activity in MVLN cells, and induced the vitellogenin (vtg) expression in zebrafish larvae, showing the typical estrogenic effects. The in vitro protein assays further revealed that PrP and BuP could bind with two isoforms of estrogen receptors (ERs). The estrogenic activities of parabens were predicted to be positively correlated with their chemical structure complexity by using molecular docking analysis. Furthermore, the synthesis and secretion of estradiol (E2) and testosterone (T) were significantly disturbed in H295R cells and zebrafish larvae, which could be regulated by paraben-induced transcriptional disturbance in both in vitro steroidogenesis and in vivo hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal (HPG) axis. Parabens could disturb the endocrine system by activating the ERs and disrupting the steroid hormone synthesis and secretion, suggesting their potential deleterious risks to the environment and human health.
abstract_zh: 对羟基苯甲酸酯（parabens）因其广泛应用和潜在的内分泌干扰活性，其健康风险日益引起关注。本研究采用多层次方法，系统研究了四种典型对羟基苯甲酸酯，包括对羟基苯甲酸甲酯（MeP）、对羟基苯甲酸乙酯（EtP）、对羟基苯甲酸丙酯（PrP）和对羟基苯甲酸丁酯（BuP）在雌激素受体和类固醇激素相关内分泌干扰中的作用。对羟基苯甲酸酯暴露促进了MCF-7细胞的增殖，增加了MVLN细胞中的荧光素酶活性，并诱导了斑马鱼幼鱼中卵黄蛋白原（vtg）的表达，显示出典型的雌激素效应。体外蛋白质测定进一步揭示，PrP和BuP能够与两种雌激素受体（ERs）亚型结合。通过分子对接分析，预测对羟基苯甲酸酯的雌激素活性与其化学结构复杂性呈正相关。此外，在H295R细胞和斑马鱼幼鱼中，雌二醇（E2）和睾酮（T）的合成与分泌受到显著干扰，这可能是由对羟基苯甲酸酯诱导的转录干扰所调控，涉及体外类固醇生成和体内下丘脑-垂体-性腺（HPG）轴。对羟基苯甲酸酯可通过激活ERs和干扰类固醇激素的合成与分泌来扰乱内分泌系统，表明其对环境和人类健康具有潜在的不良风险。
